label: On-Cycle Elections

notes.note: overlay checked; identical calendars, six cells each, middle column red, arrow point matches
review fix: removed miter class from arrow-head; round joins like the rest of the set
Review fix verified by the independent reviewer (creative director)

corrections.what: Made the two calendars identical: the right one is the left one moved 131.9 px, with one frame width (77.78 px), one header rule height and one binding spacing
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats and the catalogue ('two equal small calendars'). The sheet's frames measure 78.26 and 77.28 px wide; their parts sit 131.4 to 132.5 px apart. Edges move up to 0.5 px.

corrections.what: Centred each calendar's bindings and date grid on its frame and put the three date columns on even steps (20.96 px)
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry and equal repeats. Column centres fit at 28.25, 49.07 and 70.18 (left calendar's frame); the lower middle cell sat about 1 px left of the axis on both calendars and now sits on it.

corrections.what: Made each row's two side cells one size (upper row 8.3 x 11.3 px, lower row 7.5 x 9.85 px), keeping the wider middle cells (16.5 x 12.2 and 12.7 x 9.95 px) and the upper row's larger cells
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats where the drawing plainly means them. The sheet's upper-left cells measure 7.0 to 7.4 px wide and the upper-right ones 9.5 px; the middle column, the highlighted date, is drawn wider on purpose in both rows and both calendars. Cell edges move up to 1.2 px.

corrections.what: Made the arrowhead symmetric about the level shaft (y 56.22) with round joins, as on every other level arrow in the set
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The barbs fit at 49.4 and 49.9 deg. A miter point was tried and removed at review: the sheet draws this tip as it draws R-07's, and the set's arrows use round joins; the tip sits about 1 px behind the sheet's sharper point, as elsewhere in the set.

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at the set line weight W, 5.5 px; date cells are filled shapes
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. This icon measures 5.5 px.

source_notes: Kept as drawn: six date cells per calendar in two rows of three (counted on both sheets); the same position highlighted in both calendars, the middle column of each row; bindings crossing the frame's top edge; the detached arrow between the calendars, pointing right. Red: the four middle date cells and the arrow. Black and red sheets agree within a fringe (sheet IoU 0.911).
